Turn a long stream into vertical clips without scrubbing the whole thing. Meet GTA Six Clipper.
Give it a stream or video link. It transcribes locally and looks for peaks in chat and loudness.
Those signals help pick moments. You can add an AI pass, but you do not have to.
It cuts the clip, puts the streamer above the game, and adds a hook and word by word captions.
Review each short before sharing. You can adjust the edit, and the original stays intact.
The tool is free, but optional services may cost money. Get the creator's permission before posting their footage.
